content.name: Ethan Caldwell
content.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
content.summary: Cybersecurity analyst with nine years in IT and security, including three in a managed security operations center. Now the lead analyst for a 30-clinic medical group, where I cut mean time to contain endpoint threats from five hours to 40 minutes. Holds Security+, CySA+ and GCIH and writes detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

experience.title: Network Operations Technician
bullets: Monitored firewalls and branch connectivity for 14 branches and resolved most outages before tellers noticed.
Reviewed firewall rules with the security officer and removed 220 unused rules from a set of 900.
Helped prepare evidence for annual FFIEC-based IT examinations.

experience.title: SOC Analyst
bullets: Triaged roughly 90 SIEM alerts per shift across 40 client environments in Splunk, escalating confirmed incidents within 30 minutes.
Tuned noisy correlation searches, lowering false positives for the three largest clients by 45%.
Investigated a business email compromise for a client law firm and recovered $86,000 in a wire transfer by alerting the bank within hours.
Promoted from Tier 1 to Tier 2 after 14 months and trained six new analysts.

experience.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
bullets: Lead day-to-day detection and response for 2,400 endpoints across 30 clinics, using CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Sentinel.
Reduced mean time to contain endpoint threats from five hours to 40 minutes with automated isolation playbooks.
Wrote 35 detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, focused on ransomware precursors seen in healthcare.
Run quarterly tabletop exercises with clinical leaders and supply findings for the annual HIPAA security risk analysis.

achievements.title: Top 10% finish, regional capture-the-flag
achievements.detail: Placed in the top tenth of 300 teams at a Research Triangle CTF in 2024.

achievements.title: Volunteer, cyber safety talks
achievements.detail: Give scam-awareness talks to seniors at Raleigh community centers several times a year.
